labels.device: Radiation sensor (demonstration of device integration). Consumer detectors measure background radiation on Earth, not the space radiation environment.

shieldingTips: Move to the most shielded area designated by the mission (e.g. water or supply-lined storm shelter).
Keep the detector with you so dose during the event is recorded.
Minimise time in lightly shielded areas until the event ends.
explainer: Flight crews use qualified dosimeters and space-weather forecasts to monitor radiation. The habitat's detector streams through the Helios Hub into the same analysis, so a flight dosimeter can plug in the same way.
source: TODO(verify): CSA 'Monitoring Radiation for Astronaut Health'; NASA HRP Space Radiation
